{"query": "WITH u AS (SELECT DISTINCT Ensembl AS g FROM proteinatlas),
s AS (
  SELECT Gene AS g,
    CASE Cancer
      WHEN 'Colon Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)' THEN 'Colon'
      WHEN 'Colon Adenocarcinoma (validation)' THEN 'Colon'
      WHEN 'Lung Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)' THEN 'Lung'
      WHEN 'Lung Adenocarcinoma (validation)' THEN 'Lung'
      WHEN 'Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)' THEN 'Pancreatic'
      WHEN 'Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma (validation)' THEN 'Pancreatic'
      WHEN 'Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma (TCGA)' THEN 'KRCC'
      WHEN 'Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma (validation)' THEN 'KRCC'
    END AS can,
    CASE WHEN Cancer LIKE '%(TCGA)' THEN 'TCGA' ELSE 'VAL' END AS set,
    (CASE WHEN ("potential prognostic - favorable" IS NOT NULL AND "potential prognostic - favorable" <> '')
          OR ("validated prognostic - favorable" IS NOT NULL AND "validated prognostic - favorable" <> '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::INT AS fav,
    (CASE WHEN ("potential prognostic - unfavorable" IS NOT NULL AND "potential prognostic - unfavorable" <> '')
          OR ("validated prognostic - unfavorable" IS NOT NULL AND "validated prognostic - unfavorable" <> '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::INT AS unf
  FROM cancer_prognostic_data
  WHERE Cancer IN ('Colon Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)','Colon Adenocarcinoma (validation)',
                   'Lung Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)','Lung Adenocarcinoma (validation)',
                   'Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)','Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma (validation)',
                   'Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma (TCGA)','Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma (validation)')
),
s2 AS (
  SELECT g, can, set,
    CASE WHEN fav=1 AND unf=1 THEN 'Conflicting'
         WHEN fav=1 THEN 'Favourable'
         WHEN unf=1 THEN 'Unfavourable'
         ELSE 'None' END AS st
  FROM s
),
both AS (
  SELECT u.g
  FROM u
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s2 x WHERE x.g=u.g AND x.set='TCGA')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s2 y WHERE y.g=u.g AND y.set='VAL')
),
canlist AS (SELECT DISTINCT can FROM s2),
pair AS (
  SELECT b.g, cl.can,
    (SELECT x.st FROM s2 x WHERE x.g=b.g AND x.can=cl.can AND x.set='TCGA') AS tc_st,
    (SELECT y.st FROM s2 y WHERE y.g=b.g AND y.can=cl.can AND y.set='VAL') AS va_st
  FROM both b CROSS JOIN canlist cl
)
SELECT can, tc_st, va_st, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM pair
GROUP BY can, tc_st, va_st
ORDER BY can, tc_st, va_st"}
